name: Hive 1.5.4
notes: Fixes the primary agent silently never answering (stuck on 'thinking…') in a solo workspace after the local identity changed — e.g. the author id switching from a device/anon id to your GitHub account on sign-in left chats whose recorded owner no longer matched this device, so the ownership check skipped the turn. In a solo workspace (one human) this device now always answers, since there is no other device to defer to. Includes 1.5.3's per-turn dispatch diagnostics (provider/model/dir/isolation, completed/failed) and the empty-working-dir spawn fix.
